title: These 20+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (October 19-23)
summary: Including one of the biggest Xbox first-party releases of 2026!

Manage Topics Xbox Features Weekly Roundup Xbox One Xbox Series X Xbox Series S These 20+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (October 19-23) Including one of the biggest Xbox first-party releases of 2026! by Fraser Gilbert 7 hours ago Share: Welcome to your Xbox games roundup for October 19-23 ! We're starting to feel the presence of GTA 6 around the corner as the major new releases begin to dry up, but there are still some really interesting new games on the way including Final Fantasy Resonance and the massive Xbox first-party release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 ! Here's what's coming to Xbox next week: On this page: These 20+ Games Are Coming To Xbox Next Week (October 19-23) 1. New Xbox Releases (October 19-23) 2. Xbox Game Pass Titles New Xbox Releases (October 19-23) Watch on YouTube DuneCrawl (October 19): "DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game where you and up to three friends explore the sandy seas atop a gigantic Crab Crawler." Shoresy: Legends of the North (October 19): "Create your skater and join the Sudbury Blueberry Bulldogs on a quest to save the world from the legendary Hockey Godz, or go head-to-head with friends with a roster of fan-favourite characters." Candlemates (October 20): "Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference!" Christmas Across America Collector’s Edition (October 20): "Journey into the heart of winter America to create traditions, find hidden treasures, and experience the magic of the coziest time of year." Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey Collector’s Edition (October 20): "Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon! This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon!" Elite Sports Gaming Football (October 20): "Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life." Family Journey: Hidden Across The World Collector’s Edition (October 20): "Pack your bags and join a loving family on a heartwarming journey around the world! Sharpen your eye for detail across 60 beautifully crafted hidden object scenes, each inspired by real-world cities and iconic landmarks." We Were Here Tomorrow (October 20): "On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. When you awaken, you find yourselves inside the mysterious Norček Industries facility with little recollection of what happened." CyberBot: Zero (October 21): "In this thrilling 2D platformer, you play as CyberBot, a brave autonomous unit that must navigate a corrupted mega-facility." Hail to the Rainbow (October 21): "Hail to the Rainbow is a first-person, story-driven adventure with horror and shooter elements. Set in a richly detailed world, the game challenges you to survive in a new reality, uncover the secrets behind the surrounding chaos, and experience the protagonist’s memories and inner struggles." Dreadway (October 22): "Dreadway is an online co-op survival horror with crafting, proximity voice chat, terrifying monsters, and voice-driven interactions." Entwined: Strings of Deception (October 22): "The famous inventor Christopher Edward has been brutally murdered in his own home. As Detective Karla Robbins, you take on the case." Final Fantasy Resonance (October 22): "Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin." Galeco Sports Collection (October 22): "Relive the thrill of 90s arcade games with 5 legendary, action-packed hits from Gaelco, a pioneer in the world of arcade gaming! Forget complex simulators; this collection is all about pure reflexes, instant fun, and high-speed adrenaline." Moadra (October 22): "Endure challenging combat and evolve Moadra’s abilities, solve puzzles, and reveal countless hidden paths and secrets throughout your mission to uncover your lost Neera heritage." Mortal Sin (October 22): "Descend into a surreal, ever-shifting nightmare. Procedurally generated levels, randomised quests, and hundreds of hand-crafted rooms make every run feel fresh." Spray Trace (October 22): "Grab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace ! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path." Tidy Up the Flower Shop (October 22): "Your niece has a spare key and the best of intentions. The shop opens tomorrow, and every flower you ordered is somewhere on the floor. It’s okay. You know where they all go." Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (October 23): "Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point." Carry The Glass (October 23): "Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges." Darkenstein 3D Director’s Cut (October 23): "Fast, brutal, and demanding. Darkenstein 3D doesn’t make it easy for you. You can dodge enemy projectiles, but surviving requires quick movements, precise aim, and sharp reflexes." FIRE AND ASHES (October 23): "Henry Gray is haunted by the ghosts of his past. He awakens in 1977 inside Paul Staderbeiger Psychiatric Hospital, about to begin a maddening journey that will push his sanity to the breaking point." House 2 (October 23): "As a terrible storm rages on, Tabby finds herself once again trapped in a never-ending nightmare. Uncover the mystery of the curse or succumb to it in the sequel to the 2020 horror game, House." Omni Growth (October 23): "Humans invaded a massive galactic ship and nearly wiped out an ancient arachnid species. But one hatchling survived… Now you are the last hope of your kind." Railroad Swap (October 23): "Get ready for a journey full of challenges in Railroad Swap! Help Mat, an adorable train-driving cat, build the tracks needed to guide his train to the final destination." Seahorse Soap Patrol (October 23): "When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse Soap Patrol to clean things up!" The Walking Trade (October 23): "Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost?" Vixen 357 (October 23): "This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units." Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest (October 23): "Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series." Xbox Game Pass Titles We don't yet have any confirmed Xbox Game Pass titles for the week of October 19th to 23rd, but we expect some to be announced by Microsoft on Tuesday (the 20th).
